summary: EffectCraft is an animation app for text and graphics, like Adobe After Effects. You animate text, shapes and video. Each item is on its own layer, like a stack of clear sheets. A saved list of steps can build a full animation.
use_cases: Animate a chart for a presentation. The bars grow and the numbers increase.
Make an animated title or end card for a YouTube video.
Make 50 name cards from 1 template and a list of names.
Export the same animation as MP4 for video and as GIF for chat or email.
story: EffectCraft made the animated data card for the video. The title appears letter by letter. The bars grow month by month. They show the share of the conversation for 2 themes. Then 2 counters change to the final numbers. Agentic coding ends at 20%, up from 9%. Reasoning & test-time compute ends at 6%, down from 18%. A "Breakout theme" label appears last.
recipe_note: Build the card from a list of steps. Export it as a video. Then save 1 frame as a picture.

assets.caption: The animated card lasts 7 seconds. Agentic coding grows to 20% of the conversation, and Reasoning & test-time compute falls to 6%. The data is invented.
assets.description: A list of steps told EffectCraft how to make and move each text, bar and counter. EffectCraft then drew all 210 frames and saved them as a video.
assets.how: effectcraft-cli script signal_noise_card.jsx --empty --save-as signal_noise_card.ecproj; effectcraft-cli render --project signal_noise_card.ecproj --comp "Signal & Noise card" --out signal_noise_card.mp4 --format h264 --bitrate 2500 --audio off (1280x720, 30 fps)

assets.caption: EffectCraft also saved the card as a GIF that plays on its own, at 640 × 360 pixels.
assets.description: EffectCraft exported the same animation at half size as a GIF. A GIF plays in chat apps and email.
assets.how: effectcraft-cli render --project signal_noise_card.ecproj --comp "Signal & Noise card" --out signal_noise_card.gif --format gif --resolution half --fps 15

assets.how: Saved by effectcraft-cli script signal_noise_card.jsx --empty --save-as signal_noise_card.ecproj

assets.caption: This file holds the list of steps for the card, in the same JavaScript as Adobe After Effects.
assets.description: This is the list of steps that builds the card. EffectCraft reads it like Adobe After Effects reads the same file type.
assets.how: Hand-written JavaScript (AE object model + app.run engine commands); run by effectcraft-cli script.

headless_notes: All work used effectcraft-cli script, render and render-frame. No window opened. The script engine has no String.substr; use substring. Text needs layer.property("Text").property("Source Text"). script --save-as saves the project even when the script fails, so check the output. The card uses the bundled Inter font. A 7-second render at 720p takes about 4 s on the CPU.
